about.heading: A brand built on movement and form
about.intro: Base Movement was founded on the belief that Pilates equipment can — and should — be as thoughtfully designed as the space that houses it.
leadParagraphs: Founded by design and movement professionals, Base Movement is dedicated to creating Pilates equipment that unites technical rigour, noble materials and a serene visual language.
We believe a well-equipped studio is also a space of trust — for those who run it, and for those who move within it.

pillars.title: Mission
pillars.text: To elevate the standard of professional Pilates equipment, uniting technical rigour with Scandinavian design sensibility.

pillars.title: Vision
pillars.text: To be Europe's reference in premium Pilates equipment, recognised for quality, durability and aesthetic coherence.

pillars.title: Craftsmanship
pillars.text: Every piece is produced by selected manufacturing partners, combining artisanal process with precision engineering.

pillars.title: Design Philosophy
pillars.text: We draw inspiration from Scandinavian architecture and the attention to detail of fine watchmaking: simple forms, honest materials, nothing superfluous.

pillars.title: Certified Quality
pillars.text: Certified production, with responsibly sourced materials and quality control at every stage of the process.

about.closingText: Every Base Movement piece is designed to last — in structure, material and taste. We invite you to explore the collection and imagine your next studio.
